name: Icelandic Government Scholarships (Icelandic as a Second Language)
host: Árni Magnússon Institute for Icelandic Studies / Icelandic Ministry
amount: University of Iceland registration fee + monthly stipend for room and board (Sep–Apr)

countryNotes.US: US citizens apply through Fulbright/IIE, not directly to the Institute, with a different deadline.

fields: BA in Icelandic as a Second Language, University of Iceland
note: Results in January; winners must then apply to the University of Iceland by 1 Feb. Renewable for up to three academic years (re-apply by 1 Dec).
